component: Account Hub sync discovery skip boundaries

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted #fetchSyncAccounts still fetches address books before calendars. It checks the abort signal between them, waits an abortable one-second interval, and checks again after calendar discovery. This is a limited current comparison with the historical 1375 sequential calls, not proof that the provider network operation stops immediately on cancellation. Preserve the actual skip boundaries when changing this flow; no late result or cancel interaction was run. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Current sync discovery has explicit skip checks between the sequential operations
